description: Fingerprints of the tested Windows x86 PD2/D2GL files and plugin, with activation and loader settings.
validation: All three Win32 Release suites pass with local tables/artwork. Offline testing confirmed connected campaign areas and sewer appearance before the final shared-cache invalidation correction, which has synthetic regression coverage. Clipping/water optimizations preserve synthetic geometry and reduce benchmark CPU time; broader live performance and long-session stability remain unqualified.
